regime_context: The Canada/TSX detector shows broad, eligible leadership concentrated in commodity producers: Oil & Gas Producers lead with high durability (0.68) but are crowded (z=1.04), while Gold Miners sit as the clear challenger on weaker breadth (0.267 vs 0.786). Rotation is broad (8/16 eligible) but non-directional with absorption at 0.31, and the validated edge here is only trend-gate drawdown control — rank-IC is ~0, so no return forecast is warranted. With dir_accuracy at 0.343 across 99 calls, directional conviction should be low.
emerging_watch: Watching Big Banks (ZEB.TO, rank 5, score 0.423, eligibility true, hurst=trend, durability 0.59) — the only eligible Financials theme with a positive score and trend label. The condition that retires this watch: Big Banks' score climbs above 0.9 AND its breadth improves to at least 0.30 in a subsequent detector snapshot, or it falls out of eligible (below the trend gate).

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers are the standalone leader with the highest combined momentum score and durability (0.68), plus the strongest breadth (0.786) in the eligible set, suggesting the leadership is broad-based rather than one-name-driven. The absolute-trend gate is the only validated edge and this theme is eligible and trending. However, crowding (z=1.04, crowded=true) is a CAP/size-down caution, not a reason to avoid or fade — and the guardrails explicitly forbid treating it as a sell.
theses.dissent: Crowding at z=1.04 marks this as an attention-heavy theme; the detector's own backtest shows extension/attention spikes often coincide with tops rather than further upside, and with dir_accuracy below 0.5 the directional edge is unproven.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO lags the S&P/TSX Composite by more than 4% over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners score second (1.11) and are eligible, but the breadth (0.267) is materially weaker than the leader's 0.786, suggesting concentrated rather than broad participation. Durability is middling (0.48), and the rotation margin to the leader is 0.502 — a wide gap, not a confirmed handoff. The rotation radar is directional=false, so there is no evidence of leadership transferring.
theses.dissent: Gold is the challenger with positive score and uncrowded positioning (z=0.2), leaving room for continued accumulation; precious metals often benefit from the same macro forces driving energy momentum.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO outperforms XEG.TO by more than 3% over any consecutive 10-trading-day window in the next 20 days

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities & Renewables is ineligible (below the absolute-trend gate) with a negative score (-0.115) and low durability (0.37), despite trending hurst label. The absolute-trend gate is the one validated risk-control leg in this market's history (gate_helps=true), and being on the wrong side of it is the cleanest reason to stay lean. Crowding is negative (z=-0.78) but that is not an edge — the gate, not crowding, is the discipline.
evidence: gate_helps=true — trend discipline reduces drawdown on this market
theses.dissent: Utilities are a defensive, rate-sensitive sector; if a macro risk-off impulse hits the TSX, low-beta defensives could outperform regardless of trend status, and the negative crowding suggests no one is positioned for that.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO outperforms XEG.TO by more than 5% over the next 30 trading days

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
